nodes.label: Gotcha: dynamic partitionOverwriteMode duplicates snapshots
nodes.rationale: Snapshot tables are written overwrite-first then append; session-wide dynamic mode kept old partitions, duplicating users and doubling the positive rate.

nodes.label: Time-based splits and point-in-time features
nodes.rationale: Each snapshot sees only 21 days before cutoff with 7-day labels after; train Oct, validate early Nov, test late Nov to prevent leakage (proven by tests/test_labels.py).

nodes.label: PR-AUC as primary metric
nodes.rationale: Only about 4% of users buy in a given week, so PR-AUC is chosen; champion picked on validation.

nodes.rationale: The experiment and API treat scores as probabilities.

nodes.label: Outcome-blind seedfinder salt search (choose_salt)
nodes.rationale: Instead of hand-picking a salt after an unlucky hash draw, a pre-launch outcome-blind search on counts + pre-period covariates picks a balanced salt, recorded in ab_results.json.

nodes.label: User-level hash-based sampling and assignment
nodes.rationale: Keeps users' histories intact and makes every run reproducible.

nodes.label: Temp/cache redirection to .cache/ on import ecom
nodes.norm_label: temp/cache redirection to .cache/ on import ecom
nodes.rationale: Redirects TMP/TEMP, SPARK_LOCAL_DIRS, java.io.tmpdir, Hive scratch, H2O ice_root, matplotlib, numba and Jupyter dirs so nothing lands on C:.

nodes.label: Portable MongoDB binary (ecom mongo start)
nodes.rationale: MongoDB is not a service, so it must be restarted after reboot; only mongod.exe is extracted to save disk.

nodes.label: Config override via ECOM__SECTION__KEY env vars
nodes.norm_label: config override via ecom__section__key env vars

nodes.label: Docker-free local setup
nodes.rationale: Docker Desktop's engine was broken (HTTP 500) and its disk image lives on C:, so the pipeline avoids Docker locally; docker-compose.yml remains an optional route for other machines.

nodes.label: H2O frames sent via h2o.upload_file
nodes.rationale: H2O server's default -file_deny_glob blocks files under dot-directories, so H2OFrame(pandas_df) fails with temp files in .cache/.

nodes.label: Low-memory full-data run settings (driver 3g, local[4], H2O 3G)
nodes.norm_label: low-memory full-data run settings (driver 3g, local[4], h2o 3g)
nodes.rationale: Other apps hold most of 16 GB RAM and the page file cannot grow because C: is nearly full; otherwise Spark dies with 'The paging file is too small'.

nodes.label: User requirement: nothing on C:
nodes.rationale: C: is nearly full; all temp/spill/cache directories must stay on D: inside the project, and any new tool must follow the same rule.

nodes.label: SQLAlchemy pinned <2.1 for MLflow 2.x
nodes.rationale: SQLAlchemy 2.1 breaks MLflow 2.x.

nodes.label: API re-checks MLflow champion alias every 60 s
nodes.norm_label: api re-checks mlflow champion alias every 60 s
nodes.rationale: A retrain is picked up by the API without a restart.

nodes.label: One visual system (colour-blind-safe palette, no dual axes)
nodes.norm_label: one visual system (colour-blind-safe palette, no dual axes)

nodes.label: Temurin JDK 17 + winutils bootstrap into .tools/
nodes.rationale: No system Java on the machine; ecom setup downloads JDK 17 and Windows Hadoop binaries so Spark/H2O work without manual installs.

nodes.label: ecom CLI (ecom <step>)
nodes.rationale: One CLI drives every pipeline step so the whole project runs from a single entry point (ecom all).

nodes.label: Pipeline Order (ingest -> transform -> features -> sql -> eda -> stats -> train -> abtest -> load-mongo -> report)
nodes.norm_label: pipeline order (ingest -> transform -> features -> sql -> eda -> stats -> train -> abtest -> load-mongo -> report)

nodes.label: Graphify knowledge graph (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Refresh with /graphify . --update; plain AST-only graphify update would drop LLM-extracted SQL nodes, so never pass --force.

nodes.norm_label: tree_sitter_sql missing - sql covered by semantic pass

nodes.label: Reports rendered from results
nodes.rationale: Numbers in the docs can never drift from the code.

nodes.label: Python 3.11 venv requirement
nodes.rationale: System Python is 3.13 and PySpark 3.5 does not support it, so always use the 3.11 venv created with uv.

nodes.label: Config loader reads utf-8-sig
nodes.rationale: PowerShell 5.1 Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a BOM.

nodes.label: Gotcha: PySpark collect() converts timestamps to local zone
nodes.norm_label: gotcha: pyspark collect() converts timestamps to local zone
nodes.rationale: collect() shifts timestamps to IST; format inside Spark with date_format or use toPandas() which respects session UTC.

nodes.label: Seeded synthetic generator (Kaggle schema)
nodes.rationale: Real data needs a Kaggle account; the generator reproduces schema plus realistic structure (weekly intent, mid-November sale, weekend effects, price sensitivity, dirty rows).

nodes.label: Disk space mitigations (mongod-only extraction, gzip chunked CSVs)
nodes.norm_label: disk space mitigations (mongod-only extraction, gzip chunked csvs)
nodes.rationale: D: once had 0.3 GB free; the MongoDB zip ships 1.5 GB of .pdb symbols and gzip CSVs cut 1.5 GB to 232 MB.

nodes.label: Synthetic data source (data.source: synthetic)
nodes.rationale: No Kaggle credentials available, so a seeded generator with the exact Kaggle CSV schema is the default; real data via ecom download + --source kaggle.
